title: SquidSMP
description: The popular fan server for ThatChiefGuy
body:
### 🦑 Welcome to SquidSMP
This is the popular and official Minecraft Fan Server for the YouTuber [ThatChiefGuy](https://www.youtube.com/@ThatChiefGuy).

This is a whitelisted server and you must join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/mfgYbsxPc7) and apply there, to be able to join.

### 📋 How to Join?
- Join the Discord -> https://discord.gg/mfgYbsxPc7
- Read the channel "ℹ️┃squid-server-information" and follow all steps there.
- Submit a whitelist application in the "📒┃squid-smp-rules" rules. You must get the self assigned role from this channel.
- Wait for approval, you'll be able to join after that!
